uutiset.t: South Africa’s Woolworths, Momentum Face Investor Pay Challenges
uutiset.s: Three of South Africa’s best-known companies will face challenges on issues including their pay policies and the independence of some of their directors at annual general meetings over the next week.

uutiset.t: India Stocks Erase Yearly Losses as Foreign Buying Spurs Rebound
uutiset.s: Indian shares advanced on Monday, recouping all their losses this year following a return of foreign money and the recent unraveling of the AI trade that revived demand for overlooked markets.

uutiset.t: South Korea Says Market Measures Will Ease Investor Jitters
uutiset.s: South Korea reiterated its commitment to stabilize equity markets, but the measures failed to soothe investor sentiment, with the benchmark Kospi slumping another 5% on Monday following last week’s selloff.

uutiset.t: India’s Appeal Grows as Global Tech Selloff Deepens
uutiset.s: India’s appeal as an anti-AI market is growing as the global tech selloff deepens. From stocks to the currency, Indian assets are drawing fresh foreign interest as several tailwinds fall into place. Bloomberg’s Abhishek Vishnoi explains what to watch this week. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: European Gas Surges as Cold Snap Threatens Tight Inventories
uutiset.s: European natural gas prices jumped after temperature forecasts shifted sharply lower, which could put further pressure on inventories already depleted by export disruptions stemming from the US-Iran war.

uutiset.t: India’s Nifty Stands Apart as Global Stocks, Gold Suffer Rare Joint Selloff
uutiset.s: India’s equity benchmark climbed as the S&P 500, MSCI’s Asia gauge and gold each lost more than 5% last week.

uutiset.t: Tata Steel to Acquire 26.4% in APL Apollo Tubes for $1.7 Billion
uutiset.s: Tata Steel Ltd. has agreed to acquire a 26.4% stake in APL Apollo Tubes Ltd. for as much as 155.1 billion rupees ($1.7 billion), deepening its presence in India’s structural steel products market.

uutiset.t: MSCI Discussed Avoiding Indonesia Downgrade With Prabowo, Dalio
uutiset.s: MSCI Inc. Chief Executive Henry Fernandez conveyed a willingness to consider alternatives to a two-step downgrade of Indonesia’s stock-market status in recent direct talks with President Prabowo Subianto, according to people with knowledge of the discussion.

uutiset.t: Asia Market Measures May Buffer Stock Losses: BNP
uutiset.s: Jason Lui, Head of APAC Equity Derivative Strategy at BNP Paribas, says market support measures in China, Taiwan and South Korea may provide a buffer against weak sentiment, but longer-term investment returns will still face long-term uncertainty from US data-center regulations and restrictions on r

uutiset.t: Why Asia Market Stabilization Measures May Not Be Enough
uutiset.s: Bloomberg's Lianting Tu talks about investor sentiment that recent stabilization measures in China, Taiwan and Korea are not quite enough, and how near-term outlook depends on dip buying and whether hedge funds keep cutting positions. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Taiwan Stocks See Biggest Leverage Unwind in at Least 30 Years
uutiset.s: Taiwan stocks saw the biggest unwind of leveraged bets in at least three decades on Friday, helping to explain why the authorities’ efforts to stem the selloff in Asia’s most tech-heavy market are having a limited impact.

uutiset.t: China’s Record State Fund Rescue Masks Deepening Investor Gloom
uutiset.s: China’s state-backed funds poured a record amount of money into the market on Friday in another forceful attempt to stem a deepening selloff.

uutiset.t: ICICI Prudential Seeks $800 Million as Alternatives Push Grows
uutiset.s: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Co. is seeking as much as $800 million for private credit and special opportunities funds, according to people familiar with the matter, tapping growing demand for alternative assets from wealthy investors and institutions.

uutiset.t: Copper Falls Below $12,000 in London as Metals Turmoil Deepens
uutiset.s: Copper briefly sank below $12,000 a ton on the London Metal Exchange, deepening a sharp selloff as doubts grow about demand from artificial intelligence.

uutiset.t: Gold Rebounds as Dip-Buyers Step In After Worst Week Since March
uutiset.s: Gold rebounded from its biggest weekly decline in eight months, with dip-buyers stepping in as the market pared bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.
